newFaq.title: Frequently asked
newFaq.subtitle: Have a question? We probably already have the answer.
newFaq.q1: Do I need to sign a contract?
newFaq.a1: No. Beauty Calendar works on a monthly basis with no commitments. You can cancel anytime with one click.
newFaq.a2: On average 10-15 minutes. Add services, staff, working hours — and you're done. We also offer free help with migration from other systems.
newFaq.q3: Can I transfer data from Booksy/Fresha?
newFaq.a3: Yes! Our team will help you transfer your client list and visit history for free. Write to us at support@beautycalendar.pl.
newFaq.a4: AI analyzes your data (bookings, no-shows, revenue) and automatically suggests optimizations. You don't need to configure anything — it works from day one.
newFaq.a5: Yes, Beauty Calendar works as a PWA (Progressive Web App). Add to home screen and use it like a native app on iOS and Android.
newFaq.a6: We offer support via chat, email, and phone. We respond within a maximum of 4 hours on business days.
newFaq.a7: Yes, absolutely. Beauty Calendar charges a fixed monthly fee depending on your plan (0 PLN / 99 PLN / 199 PLN). Zero commission on bookings — whether your client books 1 or 1000 appointments per month. This is our fundamental difference from Booksy and similar platforms.
newFaq.q8: Does it integrate with Google Calendar?
newFaq.a8: Yes. On PRO and VIP plans you get two-way sync with Google Calendar. Appointments from Beauty Calendar automatically appear in your Google Calendar and vice versa — blocks from Google Calendar block slots in your booking widget.
newFaq.q9: What if I change my mind?
newFaq.a9: No commitments. Cancel anytime. No questions asked, no hidden fees. We also guarantee a full refund within the first 30 days.

systemFlow.label: How it works
systemFlow.title: One client. Five visits.
systemFlow.step1t: Booking in 30 seconds — no app needed
systemFlow.step1d: The client opens a link, picks a time, and books. No app download, no account creation, no phone call. 30 seconds from click to confirmation. No other system on the market offers this.
systemFlow.step1alt: Online booking in 30 seconds without an app — Beauty Calendar
systemFlow.step2d: Other systems send a dry reminder. Yours sends educational content about the booked service — the client anticipates the visit like a gift. Result? −67% no-shows in the first month.
systemFlow.step3d: The stats are brutal: 60% of new clients don't return after their first visit. The system sends perfectly timed messages that guide the client from visit one to visit five — automatically, without your involvement.
systemFlow.step4t: Churn Radar — AI that never sleeps
systemFlow.step4d: AI analyzes every client's behavior and detects churn signals 3 weeks early. Before the client forgets about your salon, she gets a personalized return offer. You don't even know she was at risk.
systemFlow.step4alt: Churn Radar — AI detects at-risk clients 3 weeks early
systemFlow.step5d: A happy client recommends your salon to a friend. The friend gets a welcome discount, the client gets a reward. The system tracks every referral, calculates rewards, and builds an ambassador ranking. Zero effort from you.
systemFlow.step6t: True Profit — what you really earn
systemFlow.step6d: Other systems show revenue. Yours subtracts product costs, labor time, commissions — and shows real profit per service, per day, per stylist. For the first time, you know what you actually earn.
systemFlow.step6alt: True Profit — real profit per service and stylist

features.title2: that earn money while you sleep
features.subtitle1: Each one solves a problem that's costing you
features.bottomNote: That's just 12 of over 60 Beauty Calendar features
features.c1desc: The system monitors every client after their visit. 14 days of silence → gentle reminder. 30 days → special offer. 60 days → comeback discount. 90 days → last chance. You set the content once — the system runs non-stop. Even while you sleep.
features.c1metric: 67% of clients with a sequence come back
features.c2desc: AI analyzes each client's patterns and flags them as: safe, at-risk, or critical — before they even decide to leave. You get an alert with the client's name and a suggested action. You react before you lose the appointment.
features.c3title: Digital loyalty program — no cards needed
features.c3desc: A digital visit counter runs silently for every client. After the 5th visit: an automatic reward message. 'Anna, you've earned a free nail art! 💜 Just mention your reward at your next visit.' No physical cards. No manual counting. Clients return because they know something special is coming.
features.c4desc: A client who missed 2 appointments without canceling gets flagged as 'high risk' by AI. Next booking — the system automatically requires a deposit. No awkward conversations. The client pays upfront or books elsewhere.
features.c5desc: We don't send 'Reminder: appointment tomorrow at 11:00.' We send: 'Anna, your manicure is at 11:00 tomorrow 💅 Last time you chose Dusty Rose — we have it ready!' Personalized based on client history. One sentence that says you remember her.
features.c6desc: Client didn't show up. 30 min later: 'We missed you — everything OK? 🤍' 24h no response: 3 suggested open slots. 48h still no booking: exclusive offer just for her. Three stages. Fully automatic. Zero effort from you.
features.c7desc: The client downloads Beauty Calendar and links to your salon. From that moment — she sees only you. Not a marketplace. Not competitors. Not ads for other salons. Just your services. Your availability. Your notifications. It's your private channel to clients — forever.
features.c7metric: Zero competitor ads in the app
features.c8title: Widget per campaign — know what works
features.c8desc: Separate booking widget for each ad. Instagram gets a different link than your website. Google Ads gets a different one than TikTok. You see exactly: which campaign brought how many bookings and what value. Stop wasting budget. Scale what works.
features.c9desc: After the 3rd visit, clients get their unique referral link. 'For every new client — free nail art! 💜' You see: clicks, bookings, value of each referral in dollars. Influencer marketing with measurable ROI — in every salon.
features.c10title: An export that's actually worth something
features.c11desc: The system automatically groups clients by purchase behavior: who books services over $50, who comes every 4 weeks, who tries new services, who books only on weekends. Create custom groups by your own criteria. Send offers exactly to those who are waiting for them. Not to all 847 clients at once.
features.c12title: True Profit — how much you really earn
features.c12desc: Enter the treatment recipe once. The system deducts used materials from inventory and shows how much you REALLY earn per treatment — not revenue. Real profit after costs. Most owners discover their 'best service' earns 3× less than they thought. Now you know what to promote — and why.
features.exportBcList: full visit history, amounts spent, preferences, purchase groups, visit frequency, last service, consultation card notes.
features.exportConclusion: This isn't a contact list. It's a knowledge base about your clients. Marketing that actually converts starts here.
